aboutContent.summary: Adobe Certified Expert AEM Developer with 4+ years of experience implementing enterprise CMS solutions using AEM 6.5 and AEM as a Cloud Service. Experienced in AEM component development, content architecture, headless CMS implementation, Content Fragment modeling, GraphQL persisted queries, and frontend integration. Designed the content architecture for the migration of a TeamSite-Angular application to a headless AEM architecture, including Content Fragment Models, field definitions, content relationships, GraphQL query implementation, and Universal Editor integration. Developed an AEM-hosted administrative utility for cross-environment content migration, publishing operations, and cache invalidation. Technical experience includes Java, HTL, Apache Sling, Sling Models, OSGi, JCR/Oak, Oak/Lucene indexing, production deployment workflows, security remediation, and AI-assisted development.

projects.name: Citi ThankYou Rewards: AEMaaCS Headless Migration
achievements: Designed the headless content architecture for migration from TeamSite-Angular to AEM as a Cloud Service by analyzing existing pages and components and defining Content Fragment Models, field structures, and content relationships.
Implemented Content Fragment Models and Content Fragments based on the approved content architecture and developed GraphQL persisted queries for structured content retrieval and frontend integration.
Integrated Universal Editor with the Next.js frontend to enable in-context content authoring and used Cursor AI for implementation assistance, code generation, and development workflows.

Developed and enhanced an AEM-hosted administrative utility for cross-environment content migration, publishing operations, and cache invalidation between Dev and QA environments within a single AEM instance.

Managed implementation and deployment across 24+ biweekly releases for EU and APAC platforms with zero rollback incidents.
Optimized Oak/Lucene indexes to improve JCR query execution performance.
